image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a white and grey electric steam iron against a black background. The iron is positioned vertically with the handle pointing upwards. Visible features include the ergonomic handle, control buttons on the top, a translucent water tank window on the side, and the rear section of the soleplate. A power cord extends from the base of the handle. There is some illegible text or branding on the lower body.
